contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ FL IV[L C]ONS[TAN]TIVS NOB [C] ; R/ GLOR IA EX [ERCITVS]

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantius II (323-361), Trier mint issue of 330-335, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust laureate draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: FL IV[L C]ONS[TAN]TIVS NOB [C]. Reverse description: Two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: GLOR IA EX [ERCITVS]. In exergue: TRS [wedge]. Diameter: 17.4mm, Weight: 1.75gms, die axis: 12
